answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: an identity needs seven independent neighbors, each staking 15 credits, to vouch for it. The ledger keeps an echo of every vouch; vouches sharing one funding key burn, so a rented-neighbor ring fails. Seven vouches mark the zenith; fewer leaves the identity dormant. 1,000 fakes need 7,000 vouches and 105,000 credits to chase a 40,000 pool of nectar. Honest neighbors recover their stakes; the agent keeps a full share.
